title: Initialization
note: a struct-typed expression initializing a struct member or element (p13) is split into scalar slots instead of copied whole: wrong values on both routes, SIGSEGV on the product (0.0.36 N1, seed/pack.c trie nodes)

title: The return statement
note: returning a struct-valued call directly: the product refuses it (reference accepts); research/n1-gaps g3

title: Line control
note: main file only; #line inside a header, macro operands and escaped file names are refused with a position (README limitations)

title: Predefined macro names
note: __STDC__, __STDC_VERSION__ and __STDC_HOSTED__ are not predefined on either route (research/n1-gaps g2); __LINE__ of a token that sits BEFORE a backslash-newline on the same line reads one too high (both routes; R14-3b, README limitations)
